subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw core own opt-in per-agent provider-spend accounting and owner-private alert delivery as a permanent public configuration and persistent-state feature?
rationale: The implementation is broad but coherent; deciding whether this operator capability belongs in core and whether its public configuration and persistence guarantees should become supported product contracts requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the core capability
options.body: Accept the generic core ownership of per-agent spend tracking and private owner alerts, then review the implementation as a compatibility-sensitive feature.

options.title: Re-scope outside core
options.body: Decline the new core configuration and durable state contract, and pursue an external plugin or provider-specific integration if a suitable extension seam exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core capability
recommendation.body: Accept the generic core ownership of per-agent spend tracking and private owner alerts, then review the implementation as a compatibility-sensitive feature.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-boundary decision over core configuration, durable state, and operator-facing behavior rather than a narrow mechanical repair.
